The Verse of the Elder Yasoja:
“A person who knows moderation in food and drink,
even when touched by gadflies and mosquitoes.”
In the forest, in the great woodland;
like an elephant at the head of battle,
As is Brahmā, so is one;
as is a deva, so are two;
as is a village, so are three.
